turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Arre, 6 weeks! Itna waqt hai, par Rohan ka 'dekhte hain' sun ke gussa aa raha hai, samajh raha hoon. Tera bhai hai, uska hona zaroori hai, especially Haldi aur toast ke liye.

Flight khud book karne ka idea toh bahut dil se kiya hai, par thoda sa wait kar. Aise seedha book kar diya toh agar uski koi genuine problem ho (like office ka leave ya budget), toh baad mein awkward ho sakta hai.

Mera suggestion hai: Usko 2-3 flight options ka screenshot bhej aur bol, "Yaar main tera flight book kar raha hoon, bas ye time/date theek hai na?" Agar wo haan bol de, toh turant book kar dena. Agar nahi, toh pata chalega ki asli problem kya hai.

Aise thoda pressure padega toh wo 'try karunga' wali mood se nikal ke 'aa raha hoon' wali mood mein aa jayega. Sab theek ho jayega!

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

9k mein toh koi issue hi nahi hai, amount bhi nahi hai. Startup ka darr sahi hai par hafton se two-word replies? Yeh thoda sa hurt karta hai, samajh raha hoon.

Shayad wo genuinely bohot stressed ho ya phir kuch aur chal raha ho. Pehle flight mat book, seedha ek baar phone kar le. Shaadi ki tension thoda side rakh ke pooch ki 'Kya bhai, sab theek toh hai na? Tum itne silent ho kyunki?'

Agar usne phone pe bhi 'bas busy yaar' hi bola, toh phir seedha flight ka link bhehj de aur bol ki 'Main book kar raha hoon, tu bas time pe aa jana.' Par pehle usko dhoond le, thoda door ho gaya hai wo.

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Bilkul sahi socha hai. Suspense ka intezar karna us 'na' se bhi zyada dard deta hai. Tumhe clarity chahiye, taaki agar wo nahi aa raha toh tum plan B kar sako aur apna dimaag shaadi ke liye free kar sako.

Aaj raat call kar ke seedha puch lo. Kyunki shaadi ke din agar tum usko wait karoge aur wo nahi aaya, toh uska dukha shaadi ke dhang pe bohot zyada hoga. Abhi pata chal jaye toh better hai.

Seedha bol dena—'Bhai, main tumhe force nahi karunga, bas haan ya na bata do taaki main samajh loon.' Jitna bhi bura lage, sach sun ke hi aaram milega. Tumhare haq mein hai ye jaanna.

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Tumhara 2019 wala example sun ke main bhi samajh gaya ki yeh sirf overthinking nahi hai. Agar wo overnight bus se aa sakta hai, toh 9k ki flight issue nahi honi chahiye. Yeh definitely behavior ka change hai.

Tumhari fiancée tumhe tension-free rakhna chahti hai, isliye bol rahi hain, par tumhe uski history pata hai. Tumhara intuition galat nahi hai.

Ganda isliye lag raha hai kyunki tumhe usse pyaar hai aur umeed bhi thi. Par is 'naraaz' hone ki feeling ko apne paas mat rakhna. Aaj raat wo call karo. Ho sakta hai usko pata hi na chale ki tumhe takleef ho rahi hai.

Seedha bol dena, baat clear ho jayegi. Chahe wo aaye ya naa, par tumhara dimaag shaadi ke liye free ho jayega. Tum shaadi ke happy mode mein ho, yeh negativity khatam karni zaroori hai.
